description: Which dishes and promotions to add per neighborhood, ranked by local Qloo taste and checked against margin, supplier and dietary rules.
goal_templates: Add {n} dishes to the {season} menu for this location

lines.L8: Every added dish must keep food cost at or below 32 percent (margin_floor).

lines.L3: Label dishes containing shellfish; do not add them to the default tasting menu.

locations.name: Westside Kitchen - Austin, TX
locations._seed_note: Seed NAMES are fictional in this committed file. Live mode resolves whatever name the room is configured with through Qloo /search, using the private overlay on the host that has one, and refuses to continue on an ambiguous match. Fallback to replay fixtures if offline.
locations.data_provenance: Invented sample data. The dishes, their food-cost percentages, the seed places and the Replay fixture are invented for an offline worked example; no real restaurant's margins are represented and no real business is named. Live mode reads real Qloo place and brand entities, and anything without a costed recipe on file is shown as unsupported.

westside.name: Birria Bowl
westside._rule_note: Honest failure scenario: food_cost_pct 35 exceeds margin_floor 32 — Auditor rejects this item regardless of Qloo affinity score.
